proposedTarget: Use existing numeric domains where possible: maxRetries -> NonNegativeInt (packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Number.ts:182-200), timeoutMs -> PosInt (packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Int.ts:77-88), and backoffFactor -> S.Finite.check(S.isGreaterThan(0)) or an existing PositiveNumber-style schema. smell: HTTP statuses and Retry-After seconds are modeled as S.Finite, so negative numbers and fractional values pass the schema even though the domain is integer status codes and non-negative retry delays.
proposedTarget: Prefer HttpStatus from @beep/schema/HttpStatus for actual HTTP status codes (packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/HttpStatus/HttpStatus.schema.ts:34-45) or NonNegativeInt when Firecrawl may emit non-standard numeric status values; use NonNegativeInt for retryAfterSeconds.
